AudioGraphs.setup: Search bounded installed metadata for MetaSoundSource/Patch, SoundClass, SoundCue, SoundMix, LoudnessNRT/ConstantQNRT/OnsetNRT; duplicate editable native assets or create via available native factory/UI. Do not claim WAV import creates these classes.

StaticMeshActors.setup: Use disposable project-owned Cube/Sphere duplicates and two actors, never mutate Engine asset; selected count explicitly read back.

AdvancedNative.setup: Create native class fixture only after the installed build exposes the class, subsystem and operation. Otherwise record explicit capability-unavailable outcome, not operational success.

global_acceptance: Record raw exact call and response, source/deployed identities, installed build, target project and independent outcome readback.
